method: Deterministic native checker regression. Re-link frozen engine objects twice; only eval.c changes by the published patch. Disable the ordinary evaluation cache. Preserve normal move filters. Record the chosen move/depth before and after, plus every legal candidate scored independently at 0 and 2 ply. Optional unmodified official CLI runs both depths with root filters disabled so every comparison has the advertised depth. No new accuracy sample or change to the frozen study.

fixture.origin: First non-tie checker divergence against unmodified GNUbg in the excluded-seed cache-off diagnostic. No new accuracy trials.

limitations: Two fixed validation games are not an equity estimate or an assessment of the XG tolerance.

The remaining 13/9 difference is disclosed; captured move traces first differ at a bearoff choice whose alternatives both evaluate to exactly -1.0. The fork has deterministic tie ordering, unlike upstream.
A new independently planned study with the corrected checker policy is required to measure its effect on the 44 reply aggregate.
